𝗧𝗥𝗬𝗢𝗡 𝗡𝗘𝗩𝗘𝗥 𝗦𝗧𝗢𝗣𝗦! 🔥

Renegades were 29/4 chasing 100 in 8 overs v Stars. Chloe Tryon smashed 56* off 17 (4 sixes) to win with 1 ball left.

Melbourne Renegades are into the WBBL finals. Knock of the season? 👇
